value.zh-Hant: 卡爾莫納在1926年5月28日軍事政變後以政令被任命為國家元首，1928年3月正式當選總統，此後連任至1951年去世，是任期最長的葡萄牙總統（25年）。他對薩拉查掌權起了決定性作用。
value.en: Carmona was appointed head of state by decree after the military coup of 28 May 1926, formally elected in March 1928, and re-elected until his death in 1951, serving 25 years, the longest of any Portuguese president. He played a decisive role in António de Oliveira Salazar's rise to power.
